Facts:
- The Michigan gubernatorial election of 2006 was one of 36 U.S. gubernatorial elections held on November 7, 2006.
- In the Michigan gubernatorial election of 2006, incumbent Democratic Governor Jennifer Granholm was re-elected over Republican businessman Dick DeVos and three minor party candidates.
- Ruth Johnson was the 2006 Republican candidate for lieutenant governor as Dick DeVos's running mate, and she was also a former member of the Michigan House of Representatives.
- Dick DeVos, born October 21, 1955, is an American entrepreneur-businessman and author from Michigan.
- In the Michigan Secretary of State election of 2014, incumbent Republican Secretary of State Ruth Johnson was re-elected to a second term with 53.53% of the vote.
